The question asks how many days after Captain Gerrit Mom arrived from Sulawesi with 800 troops did Mom and Tanate recapture the city without a fight.

Mom arrived on 21 July.
The city was recaptured without a fight on 28 August.

From 21 July to 28 August:
July has 31 days. From 21 July to 31 July = 10 days.
Then August 1 to August 28 = 28 days.
Total = 10 + 28 = 38 days.

So 38 days.
